subject: Pilot continuity: temporary token buffer while PO clears
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@novaplushealth.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:05 -0700
Subject: Pilot continuity request while PO in legal

Hey Maya,

Quick one — procurement just flagged our PO as "in legal review" and it looks like it will slip past the pilot window. We were mid-way through integration tests and don't want the team to lose momentum. Is there any way Redwood can provision a short buffer (tokens or time) so our sandbox stays live for another 7 days while legal finishes the PO?

I attached the current PO draft so you can see the approvers and expected sign date. We expect signatures by early next week but can't promise it given their backlog.

If there's a formal short-form you need from us to justify the internal exception, tell me and I'll get it over. Really eager to keep the evaluation running — demos scheduled with clinical ops on Tuesday.

Thanks,
Jordan Lee
Head of Integrations, NovaPlus Health
procurement@novaplushealth.com
Attachment: PO_Draft_NovaPlus_0621.pdf
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@novaplushealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 13:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot continuity request while PO in legal

Thanks for the heads up, Jordan — sorry to hear legal is taking longer than expected. We can do a short runway in most cases to keep pilots live while purchases clear, so long as we have a clear PO ETA and an internal approval on our side.

To move quickly, can you confirm: 1) expected sign date, 2) primary approver name(s) on the PO, and 3) whether the PO amount covers the pilot usage + a small buffer (we typically ask for 10%). I saw the draft you attached — that helps.

I'm looping in Ben (account owner) and Evelyn (CS) to confirm a 7-day token buffer. Ben — would you OK a 7-day, 50k-token interim grant for NovaPlus pending PO signature? We can require a PO copy and add a note in HubSpot to log the exception.

I'll hold off on provisioning until I have internal sign-off, but we're optimistic.

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0123
Attachment: pilot-topup-approval-form.pdf
